night: Everyone, close your eyes. Our one night begins.
天黑了，请所有玩家闭眼。一夜狼人杀，现在开始。
ready: Check your secret role and read its instructions. Press ready when you understand.
请查看自己的身份和技能。阅读完毕后，请点击准备。
discussion: Everyone, open your eyes. Discuss what happened during the night. Your card may have changed. Do not look at your card again.
天亮了，请所有玩家睁眼。现在开始讨论。你的身份可能已经改变，请不要再次查看底牌。
voting: Time to vote. Choose another player. Everyone must vote before the results are revealed.
现在开始投票。请选择另一位玩家。所有人投票后，将揭晓结果。
results: The votes are in. Reveal the final cards and check who won.
投票结束。现在揭晓最终身份和胜负结果。
role-markReview: Everyone, secretly check your mark, then close your eyes.
请所有玩家秘密查看自己的印记，然后闭眼。
role-lovers: Players with the mark of love, open your eyes and find each other.
拥有爱情印记的玩家，请睁眼，互相确认。
